rationale.conceptual: The model requires coupling a transient 1D heat conduction PDE with algebraic thermoelectric equations, implementing finite volume discretization, handling non-linear couplings, and iterating to steady state. It's not a textbook plug-and-play but a moderately complex numerical simulation, requiring careful engineering but not a novel research-grade algorithm.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of a parametric sweep (one script) and two transient simulations (same script with different parameters), outputting JSON and CSVs. It's sequential, straightforward, relying only on standard Python libraries, no data fetching or complex tooling.
